question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution: The correct answer is **"pranced."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Pranced"** means to walk or move around in a lively or playful manner. ((घमंड या ख़ुशी के मारे) अकड़कर चलना, इठलाना) • **Example**: *She **pranced**__ into the office and demanded to speak to the manager.* • The verb is often associated with horses or other animals, but can also be used to describe human movement. • The word has a positive connotation and suggests energy, joy, and confidence. • The correct answer is option 2. • **Correct passage**: Buck __**pranced**__ over against the sled, ______ (2) ______, sobbing for breath, helpless. This was Spitz’s opportunity. He sprang upon Buck, and twice his teeth sank into his ______ (3) ______ foe and ripped and tore the flesh to the bone. Then Francois’ lash ______ (4) ______, and Buck had the satisfaction of watching Spitz receive the worst whipping as yet ______ (5) ______ to any of the team. ​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **"Staggered"** means to walk unsteadily or with difficulty. ((बीमार, नशे में या वज़नदार चीज़ लिए होने के कारण) लड़खड़ाना, डगमगाना (छोटे-छोटे क़दमों से गिरते-पड़ते चलना)) • **"Strutted"** means to walk with a proud, self-important manner. (अकड़ कर चलना) • **"Swaggered"** means to walk or behave in a very confident and typically arrogant or aggressive way. (अकड़कर चलना, इठलाना, इतराना) 3e:Te60, The correct answer is **"exhausted."**
